description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for the ReportMailingJob functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for API responses and requests related to report mailing jobs, including response schemas, request schemas, and template schemas.

classes.name: GetReportMailingJobsTemplate
classes.description: Schema template for getting report mailing jobs, including 'isActive' flag and options for email attachment formats and report parameter date options.

classes.name: GetReportMailingJobsResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the response for report mailing jobs, including details such as id, name, description, schedule times, email info, report data, and status flags.

classes.name: PostReportMailingJobsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new report mailing job, including locale, date format, report details, email info, recurrence, activation status, and parameters.

classes.name: PostReportMailingJobsResponse
classes.description: Response schema after creating a report mailing job, primarily providing the resource ID.

classes.name: PutReportMailingJobsRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing report mailing job, including locale, date format, and start date time.

classes.name: PutReportMailingJobsResponse
classes.description: Response schema after updating a report mailing job, including resource ID and changes made.

classes.name: DeleteReportMailingJobsRequest
classes.description: Empty schema used for delete request payload.

classes.name: DeleteReportMailingJobsResponse
classes.description: Response schema after deleting a report mailing job, primarily returning the resource ID.
